reviews.title: Happy
reviews.comment: Works and looks great for the money. It’s not a super high-end 4K gaming monitor, but it does the trick for the price.
reviews.author: Sintec

reviews.title: Awesome but for the price
reviews.comment: Monitor works great for what it is, I was thinking it was a 4k monitor but hey that’s on me lol I was looking at 100’s of monitors when I was in the market and I ended up getting this one and it wasn’t 4k but other then that it works great and I like how it’ll automatically detect the high video port is active and switch to that one. Other monitors I’ve owned you had to manually switch to whatever port you were trying to use.
reviews.author: Rage

reviews.title: great
reviews.comment: Very good! I love it! The only regret is that I didn't buy it earlier, so I bought it early and enjoyed it early.
